assumptions.retain_original: Unreadable pairs retain original photo labels.
assumptions.missing_as_half: All unreadable pair scores are set to 0.5; not observed.
assumptions.mar_within_four_strata: An unreadable pair has the same mean hypothetical petal score as readable pairs with identical warm/cold tail and original label agreement. Unverifiable assumption.
assumptions.all_missing_lower: For lower warm-minus-cold bound, all unreadable warm scores are 0 and cold scores 1.
assumptions.all_missing_upper: For upper warm-minus-cold bound, all unreadable warm scores are 1 and cold scores 0.
assumptions.formal_bounds_scope: Mathematical marginal completions of 62 undefined single-reader petal scores conditional on 66 fixed AI scores, source draw weights and rounded full-frame baseline. Not population-wide petal-colour prevalence nor biological identified bounds if no homologous petals exist.

bootstrap.method: Independent resampling of 32 audited draws within each of four source strata; single AI fixed, rounded full-frame anchor fixed

scope_guards: Single AI visual reader scores from archived 128 selected pairs, not independently adjudicated flowers
The 62 unreadable pairs may not contain a comparable open corolla, so mathematical completions are counterfactual, not observational true petal ground truth
Formal missing-pair bounds are marginal and conditional on fixed 66 AI-readable scores and rounded source pair-frame baselines; cannot be interpreted as global photo-classifier validity bounds
The 128 selected pair draws are from temperature-tail and original colour agreement strata in a 681-species, 10881-pair frame; not a random 447500 photo classifier audit
The within-stratum readable-mean fill assumes exchangeable readability within four source strata, which is not empirically verified
The 2,837-taxon thermal-white photo-region slope and 3,600-taxon photographic spatial estimator were NOT refitted and must not be silently replaced by these sensitivity numbers
